pr_body:
buildTextStructureResponse can take a long time, presumably up to 25s, and is currently blocking the transport thread for that amount of time. Offloading the request to the generic threadpool will at least let the transport thread handle other requests concurrently.

Fix #109100
pr_comments: Hi @prwhelan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

Drive by comment, shouldn't this also be done for the TransportFindField/MessageStructureAction? 

It seems the cause of this bug is: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/c70956ac167908c111df33ccb845d5601f99cebc

So we should make sure all structure finders get off loaded to the generic thread pool.

issue_context.title: TransportFindStructureAction should not block transport_worker threads
issue_context.body:
### Description

TransportFindStructureAction can take a long time to process a request, potentially blocking a transport thread for handling other requests.  For now, we should offload the request to the generic threadpool.

> Blocking [networking threads](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/modules-network.html#modules-network-threading-model) can cause the cluster instability due to delay of message processing and eventually lead to a node [failing its health checks](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/cluster-fault-detection.html) and its removal from the cluster.

Relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/97916

review_comments: Why isn't `TextStructExecutor` used in this class (`TransportFindFieldStructureAction`) just like in the other two classes (`TransportFindMessageStructureAction`, `TransportFindStructureAction`)?

I'm assuming we will want to leave this in when we eventually delete `TextStructExecutor`, whereas in the other two classes we will not.  Do you think this is correct? Otherwise, I can use `TextStructExecutor` here too and the future-dev can replace this line with `ActionListener.complete`.
Good call, I think you're correct. LGTM!
